newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan likely to offer T-bills on Thursday - traders.
newsitem.headline: Japan likely to offer T-bills on Thursday - traders.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Finance (MOF) is expected to offer three-month Treasury bills (T-bills) through a price-competitive auction on Thursday, bond traders said on Tuesday.
The T-bill offer will be aimed at rolling over 1.5 trillion yen worth of three-month T-bills maturing on May 20, they said.
Traders said they do not expect MOF to hold any other auctions this week. -- Tokyo Treasury Desk +81-33432-8570
